entities.name: PMID:25084611
observations: Cross-sectional questionnaire study of Tis-T2N0M0 patients treated with breast-conserving therapy in 2007–2011; 285 of 355 eligible patients responded (80%).
The abstract reports no exact follow-up duration.

entities.name: Dose inhomogeneity and breast pain
observations: Among respondents, 135/285 (47%) reported treated-breast pain; breast volume receiving ≥110% of prescribed dose independently predicted pain (OR 1.01 per cc, 95% CI 1.003–1.017; P=.007).
Volume receiving ≥105% was associated only in univariable analysis (OR 1.001 per cc, 95% CI 1.000–1.002; P=.045); the observational result does not establish causality.
